The '''Roonans''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]].

==Biology and appearance==
Roonans were short, bipedal [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] with blue, almond-shaped [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. They possessed two wide [[Limb/Legends|hands]] with five digits each, each digit being roughly the same length. They possessed fairly large, oval heads with wrinkled skin and small [[Ear/Legends|ears]]. According to [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], Roonans had tiny [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]].<ref name="Evil Plans">{{TCW|Evil Plans}}</ref>

==Society and culture==
Most Roonans were considered highly particular, and saw the slightest mistake as a deep insult.<ref name="CN-Dataclip: Evil Plans">{{CN|url=tv_shows/starwars/?episodeID=8a250ab02c18a59a012c1d968a100084|text=Dataclip: Evil Plans|na=video file}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:Jedi_Master_Halsey.png|thumb|left|320px|Roonan [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Halsey/Legends|Halsey]], who fought during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].]]
The Roonans were members of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the last years of the Republic, Roona was represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Edcel Bar Gane/Legends|Edcel Bar Gane]].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> Even before the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], Gane had voiced concerns about [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum's]] actions and their impact on the stability of the Republic as early as [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]]. He believed that Valorum's perceived ineffectiveness would further divide the myriad politicians of the Senate to extremes. Subsequently, when [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] moved for a [[Vote of No Confidence/Legends|Vote of No Confidence]] for Valorum, Gane seconded the motion, which was resoundingly successful.<ref name="card">{{CCG|set=Coruscant Limited|cardname=Edcel Bar Gane}}</ref>

During his time on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Gane allied himself with the influential yet corrupt Senators [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]], [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]], and [[Toonbuck Toora/Legends|Toonbuck Toora]], and was a supporter of then-Senator [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="cod">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref> Despite his alliance with Taa, Gane vigorously disagreed with his fellow Senator following the bail-jumping of former Senator Tikkes, who had joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. He believed that Tikkes was not guilty of the charges against him, but rather had fled Coruscant to avoid the same fate as Senator [[Aks Moe/Legends|Aks Moe]].<ref name="tikkes">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|51|news/13411_7.html|Senator Tikkes Jumps Bail}}</ref> Gane continued to serve in the Senate up until, and possibly through, the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], a Roonan was a [[Match Master]] employed at the [[BlasTech Gikosphere]] on Coruscant. He presided over [[Team Coruscant]]'s game against [[Team Fondor]] in the opening round of the [[Galactic Cup of Limmie]]. He interrupted the game after Fondor had taken a commanding lead.<ref name="cup">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|sports/13314_1.html|Coruscant Eliminated in Galactic Cup Opening Round}}</ref>

During the Clone Wars, another Roonan Senator, [[Aang/Legends|Aang]], was an important member of the [[Military Oversight Committee/Legends|Senate Military Oversight Committee]].

One Roonan named [[Halsey/Legends|Halsey]] was a member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="Episode Guide Grievous Intrigue">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode209.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Grievous Intrigue}}</ref> He attended a meeting in the [[Jedi Temple communication center/Legends|Jedi Temple communication center]] in which [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] informed the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] of his [[Capture of Eeth Koth/Legends|capture]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]], though he did not join the rescue team.<ref name="Grievous Intrigue">{{TCW|Grievous Intrigue}}</ref> Halsey later took his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Knox/Legends|Knox]], to protect the contested [[Temple of Eedit/Legends|Temple of Eedit]] on [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]]. They were soon attacked by [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]], and though Halsey attempted to stop the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] warrior, both he and Knox were killed.<ref name="Monster">{{TCW|Monster}}</ref>

The trade center [[CorusMall]] on Coruscant was operated by Roonans.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Roonan_concept.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Concept art of an "alien Jedi," upon which the Roonans' appearance was based]]
The Roonan species first appeared, albeit unnamed, in the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM" /> Their appearance was based on concept art for an "alien [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]" that was drawn by [[Terryl Whitlatch]] around [[January 7]], [[1997]], during production for the movie. By [[May 9]] of the same year, the alien Jedi had already evolved into Edcel Bar Gane, as seen on a later sketch&mdash;also drawn by Whitlatch.<ref name="TPMIG">[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']]</ref>
